evidence.excerpt: Radulović has conducted two contract research engagements with regional electronics manufacturers, addressing conducted emission failures in automotive data acquisition hardware and supporting pre-compliance testing of consumer electronics boards. She regularly participates in informal consultations with companies in the NTP Novi Sad cluster on EMC design practice.
